The three scenarios

Same savings, same spending figures — three different choices.

Scenario 1A−

Retire at 57 — draw conservatively, bar and store money as extra only

WORKS, with margin.

Five-year bridge draw: $163,500 at live-as-now spending ($117,000 lean).

Savings at 62: $1,026,032 left at zero growth.

Bar and store earnings are extra only and are not counted in this math.

Scenario 2A

Don't retire yet — let the HR process run, decide from strength

★ His chosen path for now — Nov 9, 2026

Each month stayed adds about $4,273 take-home, plus the TSP match.

The retire-at-57 math in Scenario 1 stays true while the HR process runs — the decision gets made from knowledge, not exhaustion.

Scenario 3C+

Retire at 57 and let spending expand past $4,000 / mo

Survives — but thinner.

Bridge draw: $240,000.

Savings at 62: about $949,532 left at zero growth.

The cushion that makes Scenario 1 comfortable is largely spent before the pension and Social Security arrive.

Closing the gaps

Three things would complete this picture. Each can be added the moment he shares a bill or a photo of one:

  • One recent power bill — Potomac Edison electricity. He reports these run high, and there is no email trail at all, so even a single bill would anchor the biggest unknown.
  • The city bill amounts — water and sewer, stormwater (rainwater) fee, fire fee, and garbage/trash fee from the City of Martinsburg. All are billed on paper, so none appear in email.
  • The current insurance premium — the building and contents policies through Farmers and Mechanics, via Weigle. The April 2024 renewal is confirmed; newer premiums are paid by mailed check and are unconfirmed.

Until those arrive, the planning figures stay as they are: $1,950 lean / $2,725 live-as-now, measured from real bank activity.

Read these with the numbers

  • Zero growth, on purpose. The conservative path assumes zero market growth — real returns would improve every figure on this page.
  • Pension range. The pension range reflects the pending HR verification of 9.2 prior service years; the cautious figure is used for planning.
  • Health coverage. Free for life through spouse's retirement benefits — not a cost in any scenario.
  • Bar & store. Bar and store earnings are extra and excluded from all projections.
  • Account dates. Fidelity $657,105 is fresh at the latest market close. TSP $521,760 as of November 6, 2026, read directly from TSP.gov. Northwest Federal Credit Union $10,668 is fresh. Total $1,189,532.
